dogecoin.text: Unpopular opinion: #Dogecoin is a good thing for #Bitcoin. @ElonMusk is an ally. Doge needs to be backed by something. (And BTC needs a stable coin! haha) It detracts from the Eth ecosystem too. And the days of ‘1 coin to rule them all’ is over.
